comment: Patterns that must never appear in the public site (plan 4.10, 5.4/5). Python `re` syntax, matched case-insensitively. `secrets` also apply to every wiki Markdown file (the tool's check reads this file); `machine_paths` and `output_only` apply only to rendered output, because the Markdown legitimately holds these in HTML comments that the renderer drops (and a URL may contain such a path segment). No link or image may point into sources/ or references/ (those files are strictly private); no private-link marker may remain. `visible_text` (local pipeline plan 5): no sources/ or references/ path and no page or photo id (p0001) in what the site shows; web URLs (also href/src values) are left out first, on both sides, because a public address may contain any path. The tool's page check applies the same patterns to the page's public view, so a page that passes `sn done` does not fail only here.
